abstracts.value: Third quantization of canonical quantum gravity allows us to consider the multiverse as the playground of a field theory of universes. In the scenario where two universes are created by analogy with pair production in quantum field theory, we analyze the entanglement entropy between them and get some conclusions about the structure of the multiverse.

titles.title: The structure of the multiverse from the entanglement entropy
